mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( id, receiver_id, type, title, content, biz_type, biz_id, read_status, read_time, create_by, update_by, deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{receiverId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{readStatus}, #{readTime}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM notification WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET read_status = 1, read_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND read_status = 0 AND deleted = 0
